workflows.description: Workflow keys shown as kanban boards (domain.workflow.turbineh); ["*"] = every workflow.

dragAndDrop.description: Cards move between status columns by drag and drop and by keyboard; false = read-only board.

highlightOverdue.description: Overdue and stuck cards are highlighted on the board.

entity.description: Record kind of the board in the request (informative; boards are workflows).

field.description: Status field in the request (informative; columns are the workflow's states).

columns.description: Columns stated in the request (informative; columns are the workflow's states).

groupBy.description: Grouping stated in the request, e.g. per project (informative; with membership scopes each person sees only their scopes' cards).
